quick_actions_stats_requirements.meaning: Count of portal-visible runtime rows AFTER alias-family dedupe per property
quick_actions_stats_requirements.not_same_as: Requirements page raw tracked count (no backend alias dedupe on FE list)

quick_actions_stats_valid.meaning: Legacy compliance status bucket, not lifecycle VERIFIED
quick_actions_stats_valid.not_same_as: Requirements page stats.compliant uses lifecycle VERIFIED | SATISFIED_UNVERIFIED

days_until_next_expiry.filter: status in COMPLIANT, VALID, PENDING, EXPIRING_SOON with due_date >= today
days_until_next_expiry.meaning: Minimum days until next future effective expiry among filtered rows
days_until_next_expiry.can_include: estimated or provisional dates when no confirmed expiry
days_until_next_expiry.not_same_as: Operational expiring-soon tile (expiring_soon count uses status EXPIRING_SOON only)

quick_action_cards.backend: Aggregated property compliance_top_next_actions from persisted score recalc (v2 top_next_actions)
quick_action_cards.fallback: Generic overdue/expiring_soon copy if no persisted actions

score_denominator_headline.ui: displayScoreInfo / complianceScore.score — portfolio mean of persisted property scores

dashboard_score_card_breakdown.ui: complianceScore.components / bucket percents from persisted compliance_bucket_breakdown
